thesis: Channel breaks the normal relationship between life and mana by allowing a player to spend nearly the entire starting life total in one turn.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: Until end of turn, any time you could activate a mana ability, you may pay 1 life. If you do, add {C}.
